description: Reviewed evidence of co-component ROUTES (policy 2 of 2026-11-11; schema of 2026-11-12). A route is a supplier-evidenced way of using the package (a claim, grade or application block) with the co-components that route requires. Each entry gives the conditions and quote as printed, how the page was read, the basis of the association, the required groups (combination 'all', 'one_of' for supplier-stated alternatives, or 'unresolved' where the source does not say), the requirements the source states that the record does not hold (unrecorded_requirements), whether the requirement list is confirmed complete, and the limitations. Every record a route relies on is bound by the SHA-256 fingerprint of the complete record (requirements.record_fingerprint): if a bound record changes, the route is stale until it is reviewed again. No route is derived from the role text of a record, and no list is treated as exhaustive because it names some components.
